Volcanic Chamber under Tides.description: Shadows dance across the walls. broken statues stands near the entrance, and water drips in the distance.

Volcanic Chamber of Whispers.description: Torchlight flickers across the volcanic chamber. rough stone walls surrounds you while saltwater drifts through the chamber. You suddenly spot a Pele watching you carefully.

Ruins near Whispers.description: Shadows dance across the walls across the ruins. cracked lava rock surrounds you while saltwater drifts through the chamber. You suddenly spot a Kāmohoaliʻi watching you carefully.

Cave beyond Ancients.description: Shadows dance across the walls across the cave. damp cave surfaces surrounds you while sulfur hangs in the air. You suddenly spot a Moo watching you carefully.

Temple of Fire.description: Shadows dance across the walls. The air feels heavy inside the volcanic chamber, and a ring of volcanic stone sits beneath spiral markings. You suddenly spot a Pele watching you carefully. The legendary Maui Stone radiates power before you.
